test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"forgive"** means to stop feeling angry or resentful towards someone for an offense, flaw, or mistake. (माफ़ करना / क्षमा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to forgive her friend for breaking the promise.
 
 
 
• **"Forgives"** fits perfectly in the blank because it refers to the act of pardoning someone who has caused harm, which aligns with the context of the passage. (क्षमा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher forgives the student for being late due to unavoidable circumstances.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word for blank number 4 is **forgives**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Achieves** (प्राप्त करना / हासिल करना): To successfully reach a desired objective.

 
 
• **Example:** He achieves his goals through hard work.
 
 
 
• **Involves** (शामिल करना / सम्मिलित करना): To include or require something as a necessary part.
 
 
• **Example:** The project involves extensive research and analysis.
 
 
 
• **Contrives** (सोचना / योजनाबद्ध करना): To plan cleverly or inventively, often in a deceitful way.
 
 
• **Example:** He contrives a plan to surprise his friend on their birthday.
 
 

13a:Tcaf,
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.
